# Extracting dialog lines from a game file (2025-12-17 08:48Z)

_**User (2025-12-17 08:55Z)**_


struct DialogLine {
    u8 type;
    u8 idx;
    u8 colorIndicator;
    u8 color;
    u8 lineNumber;
    u8 separator;
    ConvText text;
    u8 end;
    if(end == 0xF8) {
        u8 action1;
        u8 action2;
    }
};

struct Conversation {

DialogLine teapetece;
DialogLine nosecuando;
DialogLine completo;
DialogLine tarifa;
DialogLine bueno;
DialogLine todavia;
DialogLine calentamiento;
DialogLine nollego;
DialogLine frances;
DialogLine aunmucho;
DialogLine luzapagada;
DialogLine solo4000;
DialogLine tupones;
DialogLine notengo;
DialogLine novuelvas;
DialogLine losconque;
DialogLine chapa1;
DialogLine puesno;
DialogLine chapa2;
DialogLine mururoa;
DialogLine chapa3;
DialogLine fisica;
DialogLine chapa4;
DialogLine paranoverte;
DialogLine tutelopierdes;
DialogLine idiomas;
DialogLine griego;
DialogLine castidad;
DialogLine vicioso;
DialogLine ropa;
DialogLine pantalonescagados;
DialogLine princesa;
DialogLine maricon;
DialogLine hasconseguido;
DialogLine enello;
DialogLine perseverante;
DialogLine tamano;
DialogLine pequena;
};

Conversation conv @ 0xB21DE;


this imhex pattern extracts all different dialog lines from room 2 in Alfred.1

I want you to extract all dialog lines, put them in a txt file, one dialog line per line, printing the HEX value when its not text, and ASCII when it is text. 

for instance the first dialog would be:


FE 01 FC 41 08 20 0A 00 ¿ Te apecete pasar un buen rato, guapo ? FD

I want this, one on each line, for all dialog lines in room 2.

end (u8)\n    end_byte = data[offset]\n    result.append(f\"{end_byte:02X}\")\n    offset += 1\n    \n    # If end == 0xF8, read action1 and action2\n    if end_byte == 0xF8:\n        result.append(f\"{data[offset]:02X}\")  #   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract all dialog lines from room 2 (conversation at 0xB21DE) in Alfred.1\nOutputs one dialog line per line with HEX values for non-text and ASCII for text.\nFormat: FE 01 FC 41 08 20 &lt;ASCII TEXT&gt; FD [optional action bytes]\n\"\"\"\n\ndef extract_dialog_line(data, offset):\n    \"\"\"Extract a single DialogLine structure and format it properly.\"\"\"\n    start_offset = offset\n    hex_parts = []\n    \n    # Read the fixed header: type, idx, colorIndicator, color, lineNumber, separator\n    for i in range(6):\n        hex_parts.append(f\"{data[offset]:02X}\")\n        offset += 1\n    \n    # Read the text portion (null-terminated)\n    text_bytes = []\n    while offset &lt; len(data) and data[offset] != 0:\n        text_bytes.append(data[offset])\n        offset += 1\n    \n    # Skip the null terminator\n    if offset &lt; len(data):\n        offset += 1\n    \n    # Convert text bytes to string (CP437/DOS encoding for Spanish characters)\n    try:\n        text = bytes(text_bytes).decode('cp437')\n    except:\n        text = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else f'\\\\x{b:02x}' for b in text_bytes)\n    \n    # Read the end byte\n    end_byte = data[offset]\n    offset += 1\n    \n    # Build result: hex header + text + end byte\n    result = ' '.join(hex_parts) + ' ' + text + ' ' + f\"{end_byte:02X}\"\n    \n    # If end == 0xF8, read action1 and action2\n    if end_byte == 0xF8:\n        action1 = data[offset]\n        offset += 1\n        action2 = data[offset]\n        offset += 1\n        result += f\" {action1:02X} {action2:02X}\"\n    \n    return result, offset\n\ndef main():\n    # Read the ALFRED.1 file\n    with open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    # Starting offset for the conversation at 0xB21DE\n    offset = 0xB21DE\n    \n    # Dialog line names (for reference, not printed in output)\n    dialog_names = [\n        'teapetece',\n        'nosecuando',\n        'completo',\n        'tarifa',\n        'bueno',\n        'todavia',\n        'calentamiento',\n        'nollego',\n        'frances',\n        'aunmucho',\n        'luzapagada',\n        'solo4000',\n        'tupones',\n        'notengo',\n        'novuelvas',\n        'losconque',\n        'chapa1',\n        'puesno',\n        'chapa2',\n        'mururoa',\n        'chapa3',\n        'fisica',\n        'chapa4',\n        'paranoverte',\n        'tutelopierdes',\n        'idiomas',\n        'griego',\n        'castidad',\n        'vicioso',\n        'ropa',\n        'pantalonescagados',\n        'princesa',\n        'maricon',\n        'hasconseguido',\n        'enello',\n        'perseverante',\n        'tamano',\n        'pequena',\n    ]\n    \n    output_lines = []\n    \n    print(\"Extracting dialog lines from room 2...\")\n    for i, name in enumerate(dialog_names, 1):\n        line, offset = extract_dialog_line(data, offset)\n        output_lines.append(line)\n        print(f\"{i:2d}. {name:20s}: {line[:80]}...\")\n    \n    # Write to file\n    with open('room2_dialog_lines.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n        for line in output_lines:\n            f.write(line + '\\n')\n    \n    print(f\"\\n✓ Successfully extracted {len(output_lines)} dialog lines to room2_dialog_lines.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n",

struct ConvText {
    u8 text_bytes[while(
        std::mem::read_unsigned($, 1) != 0xFD
        &&
        std::mem::read_unsigned($, 1) != 0xF8
        &&
        std::mem::read_unsigned($, 1) != 0xF4
    )];
} [[sealed]];

struct DialogLine {
    u8 type;
    u8 idx;
    u8 colorIndicator;
    u8 color;
    u8 lineNumber;
    u8 separator;
    ConvText text;
    u8 end;
    if(end == 0xF8) {
        u8 action1;
        u8 action2;
    }
};
